## Preserve Markdown syntax and check the implementation in CI

- Unbold removes paired bold delimiters while preserving inline and fenced code, HTML code, link destinations, horizontal rules, escaped punctuation, and unmatched markers.
- Unslop ignores suppression directives inside code examples. Actual suppression comments still work.
- CI runs the published hooks across repository files, checks Python types, and runs 27 end-to-end cases alongside the existing Python tests.
